actors.name: Bookkeeper
actors.private_context: The bookkeeper has filed the quarterly payroll return on time for the last seven quarters. She is aware of the month-end deadline and has the necessary information and forms to file. She intends to file before the deadline as usual, but may be affected by unforeseen personal or work issues.

actors.name: Herrera Bakery Owner
actors.private_context: The owner trusts the bookkeeper to file on time as she has done previously. The owner does not plan to intervene unless notified of a problem.

shared_context: The Herrera bakery operates in a jurisdiction where quarterly payroll returns must be filed by the end of the month. The current quarter's return is due by 2026-10-31. The bookkeeper has access to the bakery's payroll records and the filing system. The owner and bookkeeper have a standard working relationship; the owner does not typically check on the filing unless reminded.

starting_events.description: The bookkeeper begins her workday at the bakery. She has the quarterly payroll data available and is aware of the upcoming deadline.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the quarterly payroll return was successfully filed (e.g., submission confirmation or receipt) on or before 2026-10-31T23:59:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
